extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, representative attorneys/agents, and EPO examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Official European Patent Office (EPO) Guidelines covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition/limitation/revocation, procedural matters, application content, patentability (novelty, inventive step, industrial application) and amendments/corrections for European patent applications and patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures concerning the filing of European patent applications and the examination performed at filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter II for procedural requirements at filing, initial checks and formalities to be performed on receipt of an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Examination and verification of formal requirements for a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter III for what formalities are checked (e.g. documents, signatures, form of claims, fees) and consequences of deficiencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO communicates formal deficiencies and the rules for amendment and correction of errors in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter V for the communication process, time limits for responses and permissible corrections/ amendments under formal examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing publication of the patent application, the requirement to request substantive examination and transfer of the file to the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter VI for timings, publication content, and procedural steps to commence examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for European patent proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter VII for permissible languages, translation obligations and effects on proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal requirements and standards for drawings submitted with a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter IX for formatting, clarity, and how drawings are examined and amended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on payment, calculation and consequences of fees related to European patent applications and proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter X for fee types, payment deadlines, and remedies for non-payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for public/party access to file contents, use of the European Patent Register and certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter XI for inspection rights, confidentiality limits, and formalities for certified documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards describing what constitutes an appropriate search for a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter III for the scope, depth and objectives of the search function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance on how searches are planned and executed at the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter IV for strategy, use of databases, keywords/classes and documentation to be consulted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC and CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and practices for classifying patent applications according to IPC/CPC and preclassification steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter V for classification practice and its role in search and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and determination of the relevant prior art when carrying out the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VI for what constitutes state of the art for search purposes and how it's identified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity of invention for search purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VII for criteria used to decide whether multiple inventions are present and how that affects the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories of subject-matter excluded from EPO search work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VIII for types of content not searched and reasons (e.g. excluded subject-matter under EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for documentation produced during the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter IX for format/content of search records and citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the EPO search report issued for an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter X for contents of the report, classification of documents cited and how it should be interpreted by applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: EPO's preliminary opinion following the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter XI for the form and meaning of the search opinion, including how it relates to later substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Preconditions and formal checks to be completed prior to substantive examination by the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter II for the checklist and consequences if requirements are not met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stages of substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: The multi-stage process for substantive examination: first stage, examination of replies/further stages, and the final stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapters III–V for the procedural sequence, expectations at each stage and handling of communications and amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardised markings used by EPO divisions to indicate changes made to documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annex to Part C provides the standard marks and their interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on applicable time limits in examination and options for accelerating prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter VI for standard time limits, extension/adjustment rules and acceleration procedures (e.g. requests for accelerated processing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Special or ancillary procedures that may arise during substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter VII for procedures such as referral to Enlarged Board, special handling, and internal processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and working practices of the examining division handling an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter VIII for division composition, allocation of tasks and case management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules applying to special categories of applications (e.g. national phase, unusual subject-matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter IX for types of special applications and how standard procedures are adapted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition procedures and divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural framework for opposition, role and composition of the opposition division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapters I–II for admissibility, timing, who may oppose, and division responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and process for examining an opposition on substantive grounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapter V for examination standards (e.g. novelty, inventive step, added matter) applied in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps followed from filing an opposition to decision, including evidence and hearings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapters III–VI for sequence, party submissions, oral proceedings and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the opposition division; costs; limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for issuing decisions in opposition, allocation of costs, and procedures for limitation and revocation of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapters VIII–X for decision content, cost orders and special procedures for limitation/revocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on how the EPO communicates with parties and serves notifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter II for methods, deemed receipt, and formal notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural requirements and conduct of oral proceedings before EPO bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter III for notification, representation, conduct, language and derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: How evidence is taken, recorded and preserved in EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter IV for admissibility, submission deadlines and evidentiary standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing ex officio examination of facts or evidence and handling of late submissions and third-party observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VI for the EPO's powers to raise issues of its own motion and treatment of late-filed material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how proceedings can be interrupted, stayed or consolidated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VII for grounds for interruption/stay (e.g. national proceedings), consolidation criteria and effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed rules on procedural time limits, consequences of missing them, remedies and accelerated processing options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VIII for loss/re-establishment procedures and further processing provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and interaction between PCT international applications and European patent procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter IX for national phase entry, translations, and specific procedural adaptations for PCT cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions; impartiality of examining or opposition division; appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for issuing decisions, maintaining impartiality and the appeals process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapters X–XII for decision drafting, conflict-of-interest rules and appeal procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: The European patent application — content (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description, abstract and other parts of the application aside from the claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter II for required content, structure and formalities of the description and abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Items to check when preparing the abstract of a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter II – Annex 1 for a checklist of abstract requirements and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted units of measurement and notation compliant with Rule 49(10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter II – Annex 2 for the list of recognised units and formatting rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the application disclose the invention sufficiently for a person skilled in the art to carry it out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter III for tests of sufficiency, examples and consequences of insufficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for claims including Article 84 EPC (clarity, support by description, conciseness/formal requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter IV and Annex for examples concerning essential features and how claims are examined for formal compliance and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that the application relate to one invention or a group of inventions linked so as to form a single general inventive concept.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter V for the unity requirement as it applies to application drafting and amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing priority claims and their formal and substantive effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter VI for priority claim requirements, proofs and consequences for novelty and priority date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability — general
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall requirements for patentability under the EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter I for the high-level patentability framework and applicable legal tests under the EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and boundaries of what constitutes an 'invention' for EPC purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter II for what subject-matter is considered an invention and exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention be susceptible of industrial application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter III for tests and examples of industrial applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and treatment of the state of the art for assessing patentability criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter IV for what is considered prior art and how it is applied to novelty and inventive step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which disclosures do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g. grace periods, certain exhibitions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter V for the scope of non-prejudicial disclosures and applicable conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the claimed subject-matter is new over the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter VI for novelty assessment, relevant disclosures and evaluation methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the claimed subject-matter involves an inventive step (non-obviousness) over the prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter VII and Annex for examples and indicators used in assessing inventive step.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles governing when and how an applicant or proprietor may amend an application or patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapter I for scope of amendment rights and procedural constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General admissibility criteria for amendments to applications and patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapter II for formal and substantive admissibility tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(2) and (3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements prohibiting added subject-matter (Art.123(2)) and extension of protection (Art.123(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapters IV–V for detailed tests, examples and case law on allowable amendments and corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules affecting when amendments may be admitted (timing, stage of proceedings, opposition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapter III for interplay with procedural stages and responses to communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanisms and standards for correcting errors in applications and granted patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapter VI for formal correction procedures (e.g. Rule 139 EPC) and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index for Computer‑Implemented Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special guidance and indexing for issues related to computer-implemented inventions (CII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the dedicated index and related sections throughout the Guidelines for specifics on CII examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical keyword index and list of amended sections (2021)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indexes and lists to locate topics and understand changes introduced in the 2021 revision of the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the alphabetical keyword index and the list of amended sections to find relevant updated guidance.
